name: auto-refresh-finding-signals-on-done-merge
title: Auto-refresh the Experience Layer finding-signals cache on DONE merge so experience grows with every completed story
description: The finding-signals cache only updates on an explicit out-of-band learning_scan (no DONE/finding/hook/cron trigger), so accumulated experience goes stale until someone re-scans. Wire a never-throw, advisory finding-signals re-derive into applyDoneMergeEffects after the merge (alongside auto-bump/auto-rebuild), run on every DONE merge, writing the canonical MAIN cache (via B-37b3 resolveLearningRoot). + smoke. Advisory-only; no gate reads the cache; must never block the merge.
